links.comparator_used: Same three Chinese LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Baichuan) in base configuration without RAG (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Depression detection and suicide risk classification F1, symptom-summary quality (BLEU-2, ROUGE-L), and clinician-rated empathy in RAG-enhanced models
links.effect: Qwen3 + RAG depression detection F1 = 0.9107; suicide risk stratification F1 improved by approximately 0.15 vs non-RAG baselines; BLEU-2 relative gains 44.1–207.2%; ROUGE-L relative gains 37.0–94.0%; best configuration reproducibility overall κ = 0.93 (95% CI 0.91–0.95)
links.quote: RAG augmentation consistently improved diagnostic performance across datasets.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
